1:
### A return session starts from what changed

Today has three modes: a new workspace offers Write a post, Bring in existing work and Plan an app campaign; an active workspace resumes the last meaningful edit and shows urgent decisions; a quiet workspace says there is no required action and offers optional capture. A blank day is a legitimate state. The page must not invent a task to justify its presence. First-use setup remains private and lightweight; choosing a platform does not start account connection.

The primary suggestion is selected from a bounded attention queue. A release uncertainty or expiring permission outranks optional adaptation because delay can cause a duplicate or missed external commitment. A saved typing session is offered as Resume, even when another suggested action ranks higher. A blocked item never masquerades as the best actionable next step: it names the blocker, responsible actor and useful resolving action. Waiting on a friend appears under Waiting, without nagging them or estimating their consent. Separate items in the side column are not numbered as though the article review depends on the LinkedIn adaptation.

Why this next? exposes three short layers: the objective and source revision; the actual dependency or rule; and any AI interpretation. For the Aster fixture, the supported structural change and an existing draft justify an adaptation. No relevant performance data establishes an optimal time or likely reach. Dismiss lets the owner choose Not useful, Later, Already handled or a free explanation; Later saves an explicit revisit condition rather than silently recurring. A changed source may bring an item back only with the new reason visible.

The suggestion's picture changes with its real object. An article can show its permitted cover or a readable text extract; a demonstration can show the selected frame; a revision can show a small actual changed passage; a community-setup task can use curated contextual artwork. The picture always links to that object or an inspectable provenance label. A decorative poster is never relabeled as a product screenshot. When no suitable permitted asset exists, strong type and a short excerpt carry the suggestion. Image failure does not remove the action.

### Follow one object through the whole experience

Aster is an explicitly synthetic example used to connect the screens. The owner begins with a source story at revision 3 and a LinkedIn draft at revision 1. Today opens that exact draft in Create. Selecting the opening and applying an optional proposal creates revision 2 and leaves its review pending. Review opens revision 2, compares it with revision 1 and lets a qualified reviewer assess the exact wording. Plan may then save a Thursday-afternoon publication intention for the chosen account. This changes no provider schedule. A separate release request validates the exact package, actor, account, method, assets and time window through Channel Manager. Its receipt, uncertainty or partial outcome becomes an Outcomes item. Learn can join a verified or explicitly reported outcome to a genuine observation and propose a next question. Every step can return to the same Content record with its history intact.

This complete path has visible branches: a simple post can stop after private saving or copying; imported work can remain outside Content Desk when admission is unavailable; a reviewed piece can stay unscheduled; a publication intention can exist while preparation is blocked; and an unsuccessful outcome can still teach something. No page transition itself advances authority. The first useful result remains a durable draft the owner can reopen, but the design includes the entire loop.
2:
### Page purpose and a stable content home

The shared top navigation identifies five working modes, not five copies of a homepage. Today is an attention and resume surface. Plan is a structured planning workspace. Create opens a format-native editor. Review is a queue of specific decisions with an exact reader view. Learn is an evidence notebook with questions and experiments. Each mode has a different primary object, reading order and dominant control. The compact application bar, scope selector, search and typography are shared; the content arrangement is not. Remove page titles and a reader should still recognize a calendar, editor, comparison, evidence ledger or attention list.

Content is the stable library reached from the persistent Content control beside search, from Create's back link and from every object breadcrumb. It is not a sixth lifecycle stage. It lists drafts, briefs, published records, archived work and unscheduled ideas under truthful filters. Published work does not disappear from Create into Learn, and an unscheduled draft does not require a calendar date to be found. Content search supports actual title/body and permitted source identity, with project, campaign, format and lifecycle facets. A recent-items view and explicit Empty filter result distinguish no matching records from no content or unavailable service.

A record's Content home shows its private title, subject/project, optional campaign or family, current draft revision and linked destinations. Its side rail exposes revisions, sources, media, reviews, publication intentions, attempts and observations without flattening them into one status. This home supplies stable deep links across every mode. Breadcrumbs preserve return location and filter, and browser Back returns to the previous selection rather than resetting the entire workspace. A workspace-wide filter never changes a record's owning scope or the destination of an already-open editor.

### Relationships that stay intelligible as work grows

A single post is one native draft with optional subject/project and optional campaign. A content family is an optional relationship among a source article and adapted drafts, held by Content Desk if its existing relationships cannot express the need. It does not require a root article before writing a short post. Every variant points to the exact source revision from which it was derived and may carry deliberate local differences. A publication intention points to one exact variant plus one destination identity; several destinations create several intentions, never an ambiguous account array. A batch can group those intentions for review, but each retains its own admission and outcome.

Native draft/revision IDs remain authoritative. Proposed new relationships use owner-qualified references and explicit relation kinds such as derived-from, adapted-for, corrects, replaces or part-of-series. A copied text fragment is not automatically a live dependency. On source change, the user sees which supported claims or variants are affected and may update, keep an intentional historical version, or sever an incorrect derivation with explanation. A core change cannot silently mutate an already approved descendant.

A materialized ReviewPackage freezes body, media order/version/crop, links, accessibility text, author/attribution, method/source basis and the declared review scope. An editorial package can lack a destination; it then records destination-unbound and cannot satisfy destination-specific release validation. A PublicationPackage adds account, audience, route, allowed time window, consent and release authority. Any package identifier must be content-addressed or version-bound under the owner contract. These are proposed domain contracts, not existing fields asserted by the pictures.

### Independent states instead of one green status

The UI keeps at least six dimensions separate: persistence (local, saving, confirmed, conflict or unknown); editorial work (idea, draft, awaiting review, changes requested, editorially accepted or archived); evidence readiness (unchecked, supported, needs evidence, changed or inaccessible); media (candidate, under review, released, rejected or missing); release (no intention, proposed, authorized, admitted, dispatching, uncertain, partial, published or cancelled); and observation coverage (none, reported, verified, stale or incomplete). Compact rows show the two dimensions relevant to the user's current task and disclose the rest on inspection. A green source check cannot stand for approval, and a published receipt cannot stand for a successful marketing outcome.

Every transition names its actor, preconditions, exact base revision, admitted result and failure return. Save advances persistence and a draft revision. Apply suggestion changes content, never review acceptance. Request review freezes a package and creates a decision request. Accept wording records an editorial decision for that package. Authorize release names the destination/action/time scope. Admit release returns an actual local/provider state. Reconcile records observed external truth. Learn proposes a hypothesis change. Denials preserve the prior admitted state; uncertain writes retain operation identity and await reconciliation.
3:
### Intake is a reviewable transfer, with a resumable result

The import flow is Select source → Inspect extraction → Map destination and relationships → Save allowed parts → Reopen the admitted result. It is a task page, not an editor pretending the transfer already happened. The selected-source header shows the immutable input pin and whether it was actually read. Body, links and each media placement have their own result rows. Unsupported blocks remain attachments or visibly unresolved content; the user can inspect their originals. The chosen method and producer basis remain visible beside mapping, with no generated replacement text.

A successful partial intake opens the admitted Content record with a persistent, specific task such as Resolve image 2. It does not send the owner back to the beginning or repeatedly reimport the body. Retry media targets the original operation/media key and current destination revision. A response timeout first opens admission reconciliation, while a definite rejected item can be retried after the cause changes. The source article and companion variants can be mapped together or separately; the preview spells out whether each action creates a new native draft, proposes a new revision or only links an existing record.

On phone, source summary precedes an ordered extraction list and a single destination step. Long content remains readable in a full-screen preview. The final confirmation shows exactly which parts will be saved and which are withheld; it does not hide a missing-image warning below the button. Returning after interruption restores the same source pin, mapping and item outcomes, and asks for renewed validation if access or revision changed.
4:
### Evidence is navigable from the sentence that needs it

Selecting a claim highlights its exact span and opens the supporting excerpt with source identity, pin, permitted use and scope. The source rail shows facts separately from performance evidence. A statement about putting three files together can be supported by a before/after structure; that evidence does not establish faster work or reader understanding. The inspector offers Add evidence, Narrow wording and Remove claim. An optional AI suggestion must show the replacement and preserve the unsupported original in history.

Evidence status is computed from a specific claim-source relationship and an inspectable review basis. An automated check can flag missing support, but cannot silently manufacture a qualified human judgment. If an author disputes a flag, the resolution records who assessed it and why; blocked consequential claims cannot become ready through a generic Dismiss. A private reflection can be marked Author observation without forcing a fabricated external citation.

Changing a source's permission or factual content prompts a dependency impact view: which sentences, variants, review packages, publication intentions and active schedules may depend on it. The view groups definite matches separately from uncertain affected material. It proposes recheck work; it does not mass-rewrite drafts or promise that an external schedule can be stopped. A rejected source is removed from future optional-generation context as well as from visible citations.
5:
### The editor is shaped by the artifact

Create defaults to the last saved record or a compact choice of Write, Import and Open content. A short post opens one comfortable text canvas; no large title field is required, and a private working title is distinct from public text. A long article has headings, image placement, captions, alt text and citation controls. A thread has an ordered item list with per-item limits, not a single long text box whose split is guessed at release. A silent demonstration has a storyboard with shot, action, evidence, caption and duration; rendered video remains a separate Asset Studio artifact. Switching formats creates an explicit adaptation proposal and cannot silently discard structure.

For desktop writing, the central canvas dominates, with a source/evidence rail and an optional exact destination preview. Opening AI replaces or tabs the secondary assistance pane rather than stacking another permanent column. Evidence remains reachable and its selected claim persists. At narrower widths, show one secondary pane at a time. Focus mode retains record, revision, save state and one route to evidence. The public preview is a best-effort format preview labeled by qualified format/account capability; it is never claimed pixel-identical to a provider whose renderer is unverified.

The current proposal in the C concept needs a precise anchor. Selecting the first paragraph identifies Replace opening, base r1 and the exact character/span anchor. Compare shows old and new wording; Apply creates r2 only if the base/anchor still matches. Keep original dismisses the proposal without changing text. If the user types elsewhere during generation, preserve both edits and rebase only if the owner contract establishes a safe nonconflicting merge; otherwise compare. A proposal that changes a factual claim also shows the changed evidence relationship.

### Visible optional assistance and cost

Ask for help opens a compact context and route sheet before the first consequential request: selected draft/paragraph, source set, method pin, requested result, actual runner/provider and cost basis. The ordinary choice is Keep writing here or use the existing dot-authored material. Optional agent generation must be selected, with any required spending/privacy approval. A known ceiling is displayed in currency/units from the provider evidence; unknown cost is explicitly Unknown, never an invented estimate. A context-art thumbnail is not automatically sent to the model.

Assistance states are Not requested, Preparing context, Running, Partial result, Completed candidate, Cancel requested, Cancelled or Failed. A spinning indicator includes the actual stage and a useful cancel route; it does not freeze the editor. Only received output can be preserved as a partial candidate. Retry repeats the same bounded work only under the original permission and remaining allowance, and a potentially billable duplicate requires the relevant authority. Completed candidate is distinct from applied content and accepted quality.

Keyboard and interruptions are designed before polished empty space. Undo/redo remain local editing actions until save produces a revision; undo cannot roll back a published post. Escape closes a transient pane without applying its content. Browser Back or scope switch preserves a permitted local branch and identifies unsaved text. At phone keyboard-open size, the editing canvas scrolls above the keyboard; the small status row names the last confirmed save, while destination/release actions remain outside typing shortcuts. No Enter-to-publish behavior exists.
6:
### Plan begins with the intended outcome, then makes commitments inspectable

Strategy is a concise editable brief with audience job, subject, useful outcome, evidence/offer basis, available effort and exclusions. It is not a mandatory interview for one post. Content mix is a comparison surface: each proposed artifact has its reader purpose, source, format/channel fit, dependencies, remaining work, proposed destination and reason. The owner can choose a coherent lower-effort set, remove an item or save an idea without accepting the rest. A useful plan can exclude an entire channel.

Publication is the selected C week/agenda workspace: unplaced intentions and blocked preparation at the left, date/daypart grid in the center, and a selected-target drawer. An intention may be a date, daypart or exact window. Saving it does not create a release. The drawer shows the exact variant/revision, destination identity or Not selected, eligibility freshness, preparation dependency and permitted timing tolerance. Dragging invokes the same change preview as editing the fields; keyboard Move target supplies an equivalent action.

Work shows a dependency-aware list of remaining preparation and review, with source-owned task status and Planner-owned allocations. It separates an estimate from an accepted reservation and provides a jump to the actual Planner record. Time spent does not automatically subtract from remaining effort; the owner may revise the estimate. A public target shown as a passive marker consumes no human capacity, while a manual posting step does. A source task shared by three variants is counted once.

### Accepting a plan is a set of explicit, recoverable admissions

The plan review summarizes what will become accepted content work, what remains an idea, what requests Planner allocation and what only saves publication intentions. Each command carries its own actor/revision/operation identity. The primary button can say Accept content plan; requesting Planner allocation is a separately visible optional operation. No release is silently bundled with plan acceptance. The result shows Content plan saved, Planner allocation accepted/pending/failed, and Publication intentions saved with their distinct receipts. Partial success remains durable and reopenable.

If Planner is unavailable, keep the accepted content plan and display Unreserved; do not retry it by creating another plan. If an intention failed after a plan save, resume only the failed intention. If a provider schedule already exists, the adjustment proposal names its cancellation/amendment capability and the consequences before any command. The owner can retain the original commitment while modifying unscheduled work. A distributed operation record coordinates retries and receipts without claiming a transaction across services.

Bulk planning groups only compatible selected items. Before applying, show item count, account identities, exact affected records and exceptions. A batch with two eligible targets and one blocked target offers Save eligible intentions and Keep blocked draft only when that partial choice is explicit. It never interprets an unchecked item as permission or hides the exception in a toast. Unknown route or timing data remains visible in the result.
7:
### Account selection is an action-scoped decision

A destination picker groups personal, organization and contributor-operated identities with stable handles/URLs, ownership and role, not just platform logos. Two LinkedIn accounts with similar display names remain distinguishable before preview or release. A draft's format can be LinkedIn while its account is still unselected. Selecting an account rechecks format, limits, disclosure, source/media reuse and actor permission; the resulting changes are shown rather than silently trimming text. Switching the global workspace does not retarget an open publication intention.

Readiness is a dedicated task view with separate rows for identity verification, current actor role, strategy/type activation, permitted publication route, platform/community policy, actual connection and rights. Each row has a basis and a next permitted action. A platform logo or green profile check is never the summary of all seven. X displays its standing link-only boundary and allows private text work without offering a hidden browse/connect/publish fallback.

The contributor workspace is organized around an artifact and a person, not engagement quotas. Its states are Prepared brief, Awaiting authorized handoff, Sent with receipt, Contributor considering, Accepted scope, Submitted, Changes requested, Contributor final wording accepted, Declined, Withdrawn or Outcome reported. Only verified messages/receipts support a response state. A contributor may accept a test but decline public quotation. Their public account and publication timing remain theirs unless exact delegation is established. A late response is Waiting, not an automatic failed task or a reason to contact them again without authority.

The packet preview has a clear Included/Excluded boundary: selected brief, permitted facts/media and disclosure context can be included; unrelated project history, private evidence and chat are excluded. Changing the proposed recipient, audience or rights scope forces a new sharing preview. Revocation shows what access can actually be removed and what external copies may remain. Friend participation and moderation labor are real work estimates, and community readiness can remain deferred without blocking the owner's independent article.
8:
### Review begins with the question being decided

The Review inbox separates Content decisions, Publication decisions and Outcomes needing reconciliation. A queue item names requester, object, revision/package, precise question, blockers and due basis. Changes requested returns to the author with a linked decision; it does not masquerade as a new draft. An inactive native post type is a readiness task linked from the record, not a misleading Accept wording card. Review groups work by the person who can resolve it and supports Waiting on others without making those actions available to an unauthorized viewer.

Content review opens Read final by default when no meaningful prior revision exists; Compare is available when a specific change is being assessed. It shows the entire selected artifact, with images/captions/alt text and thread order, plus a focused change index and evidence panel. The owner can switch between final reading and differences without losing scroll position. A review of a suggested edit is distinct from an editorial acceptance: Adopt edit creates a draft revision; Accept wording records a review decision only for an already materialized exact package. The C review concept's r2 is therefore explicitly a candidate revision, not an unsaved floating string.

The action bar repeats the exact scope: wording-only r2, media package, or named destination release. Request changes preserves the reviewed snapshot and opens one concrete request with an anchor and explanation. Keep current rejects that proposal, not the whole campaign. An optional comment cannot silently become a change request. Bulk editorial acceptance is available only for fully inspectable compatible packages, with exceptions retained; no global Approve all button grants publication.

### Release has its own concise confirmation

Publication review presents the exact final preview beside account identity, route, accepted content/media basis, current eligibility, author/contributor consent, desired window and what the system can control afterward. The main action is route-specific: Prepare manual handoff, Request provider schedule, or Authorize connected release. A generic Publish button cannot conceal whether the action posts now, queues locally or schedules remotely. A provider preview limitation is disclosed before approval.

A stale package opens a change comparison. Even an innocuous-looking image crop can change meaning or hide disclosure; affected review must be re-evaluated. Editorial acceptance can remain valid for unchanged wording while release eligibility becomes stale because an account role expired. The interface shows both facts. Content changes never rewrite historical approval scope. Revalidation checks current revisions at admission and at the last safe execution boundary, with explicit control limits for provider-owned schedules.

Outcomes is an operational reconciliation queue. An unknown result opens the attempt timeline, exact submitted package, identity and last confirmed event. Check status, Record observation and permitted Cancel/Amend actions appear according to current capability. Retry is unavailable until its safety condition is met. A failed second item in a thread shows the posted prefix and the remaining suffix; continue or correct is a scoped new action. Leaving this page never dismisses unresolved risk or automatically retries.
9:
### Learn has questions, observations and experiments

The selected C ledger is the starting point: source facts, publication receipts, audience observations and unsupported outcome claims are different kinds. The default view is the owner's current question with evidence coverage, not a dashboard of impressive totals. A source fact can be inspected here because it frames the hypothesis, but it is not counted as audience feedback. No-results is an informative empty state with Add observation, Import permitted receipt or Define a question; it offers no invented success graph.

An observation form asks what was observed, on which exact post/version/account, when, from what source and with which limitations. Quantitative observations include metric definition, window and denominator when meaningful. Qualitative feedback retains the actual wording or permitted paraphrase and relationship context. The user may save a private observation without publishing it or exposing the person. Missing fields remain incomplete, never zero. A duplicate imported metric is reconciled by source identity/window, not added to inflate totals.

An experiment is a bounded question, hypothesis, proposed change, target content set, expected observation and stop/review condition. Its states are Idea, Proposed, Accepted scope, In progress, Observation incomplete, Reviewed, Stopped or Superseded. Creating an idea does not schedule a campaign, recruit readers or contact anyone. Accepting it can propose content work through Plan; those commands and their external permissions remain visible. Results can lead to Keep, Change or Stop with an evidence-linked reason. Negative and inconclusive outcomes remain searchable.

Before recommending a new tactic, show the strongest alternative explanation and missing evidence. The owner can disagree with the interpretation while retaining the observation. A change to strategic canon or a post-type method is a separate adoption proposal under its native owner, with a versioned rationale. The next planning pass references the accepted learning result and its limits instead of treating every past assistant suggestion as ground truth.
10:
### Recovery is reachable from the object that failed

Every pending command has a compact operation record with actor, owning service, target/base revision, operation key, last confirmed event and allowed next action. Content home and the affected page link to it. The global status tray is a route to these records, not a second authoritative operation log. A toast can acknowledge an event but cannot be the only place an unknown save or release is explained.

Loading keeps the selected object's identity visible. Empty states distinguish No content yet, No matching items, Nothing waiting for you and Data unavailable. A service timeout leaves cached material labeled with observation time and disables only the action requiring current data. A malformed response is not success. Retry carries the original operation identity when safe; a new request is explicitly labeled when the intended effect changed. Cancel requested remains pending until the owner service confirms it.

An interrupted editorial review restores its package and reading position, but refreshes current content and authority before acceptance. An expired login retains the permitted recovery copy and names the account/workspace it belongs to. After reconnecting, the user sees any changed source permissions before that copy is uploaded or sent to a provider. If a draft was deleted or moved elsewhere, recover locally as a new candidate only through an explicit destination choice; do not resurrect it into a former scope silently.

Privacy applies to secondary surfaces too: search snippets, notification previews, thumbnails, generated context, exports, cached excerpts and contributor packets. A revoked source may leave a historical locator where permitted while its bytes are no longer displayable. An empty thumbnail is preferable to leaking private content. Audit access is role-limited and is not exposed by sharing one draft. Shared-device mode can disable local recovery and visual previews without making private saving impossible.
11:
### A Modernist Press language, different geometry per job

The owner praised the revised C task-specific pages and asked that they start this full redesign. The shared language is warm ivory, cobalt primary actions and rules, near-black text, restrained red for meaningful exceptions, confident sans-serif hierarchy and readable serif prose. Today can use expressive typography and a relevant image; Plan, Create, Review and Learn use their task's working geometry. This supersedes candidate 0.2's muted vermilion visual recommendation, while preserving its exact source and review history. It is design direction for this revision, not acceptance of every control or future implementation.

Plan uses a real calendar or agenda, unplaced tray and selected-target drawer. Create uses a large writing canvas, source rail and optional preview. Review uses a decision queue, final reading/comparison and scoped decision bar. Learn uses a ledger, evidence detail and experiment notebook. Content uses a compact durable collection with filters and object relationships. Empty, loading, error and no-art versions retain these identities. Neither a giant slogan nor a hero card belongs on every route.

### Adaptive imagery is a small, inspectable selection policy

For Today, choose the most useful permitted representation in this order: an actual selected artifact preview at the referenced version; a curated context image with rights and semantic fit; a typography/excerpt treatment; a plain no-image composition. The order can be overridden by an explicit user preference. A preview selection record names asset/source version, role (artifact preview or context art), crop/focal point, alt text, rights/permitted audience, last validation and fallback. It is presentation metadata, not proof of a product claim.

Do not generate a new image on every visit or as a prerequisite for a suggestion. Optional commissioned illustration can be offered only when it adds understanding and its cost/context are authorized. Generated art is labeled in provenance and never passed off as a real screenshot, customer or outcome. A cached image is invalidated when its source permission or selected version changes. No-art and reduced-data modes remove transfer and motion, preserve meaning in adjacent text and retain a composed typographic layout. An image failure replaces the media area without shifting the primary control under the pointer.

### Responsive contracts, not shrunken boards

At a wide desktop, use the page-specific multi-pane form. At an intermediate width, collapse the least important secondary pane behind a named control; never compress all columns to unreadable width. On phone, a stable five-item navigation remains, with Content reachable through its persistent named control. Plan is an agenda plus a full-screen target editor; Create is canvas then named Sources/Preview/Help views; Review is Read final followed by a change list and scope bar; Learn is an evidence list with one selected detail and an explicit return. Phone review cannot hide evidence or media required for a decision.

The proposed minimum touch target is 44 by 44 CSS pixels, with sufficient spacing for adjacent destructive and primary controls. Text content wraps at 320 CSS pixels and remains operable at 200 percent text zoom; test 400 percent page zoom and the resulting single-column reflow during implementation. Normal body/status text targets at least 4.5:1 contrast, large text and essential non-text controls at least 3:1, using actual rendered colors. These are explicit test targets, not certification from a raster. Cobalt alone never distinguishes selected, pending, failed or published.

Keyboard order follows task order, with visible focus and named controls. Date placement has a keyboard equivalent to drag; comparison changes can be navigated by heading and next-change actions; error summaries focus the first affected field without discarding input. Dialogs have a single clear title, initial focus, contained keyboard focus and deterministic return. Screen-reader announcements distinguish save pending, saved revision and uncertain outcome, and do not announce every keystroke. Reduced motion removes decorative movement and keeps necessary state changes perceivable.

### Readability belongs to the delivered artifact

The atlas contains full-size viewports and focused state specimens at their intended scale. The native dossier uses overview images only for composition and readable detail figures for consequential controls, with the same meaning in native text. A 1600-pixel desktop compressed to a seven-inch document cannot carry all its small labels. Figure selection and cropping are designed before export, not repaired after approval. The exact native PDF must be examined at normal page scale and matched zoom against the supplied image; sharp source pixels alone do not pass. No claim of live native-phone viewer behavior is made without actual observation.
12:
### Permission and cost are part of action design

The capability view names what the current actor may read, edit, assess, approve, release, share or administer for each scope. UI role labels simplify that truth but never replace server checks. A reviewer can inspect only the permitted package and cannot inherit publisher credentials. A contributor can control their wording without seeing other contributors' private material. An account administrator can manage supported connections only through the required security authorization.

The action preview makes data movement concrete: selected material, recipient/provider, purpose, cost/ceiling when known, and resulting durable state. Internal navigation and private editing do not create repetitive permission prompts. Account grants, third-party sharing, external publication, paid generation and irreversible deletion preserve their actual boundaries. The optional assistant route must disclose when running locally still uses remote inference. A route that fails or exceeds its authorized scope returns to a useful manual/existing-work path, without silently switching providers.
13:
### Additional connected-design acceptance

D1, title-removal test: independently inspect Today, Plan, Create, Review, Learn and Content with their page titles obscured. Identify the main object, next meaningful action and what changes when it is used. Failure means page architecture needs revision even if typography is attractive. Test the actual delivered pixels, not their captions.

D2, connected object trace: start at Today with Aster source r3 and LinkedIn draft r1; navigate into the editor, apply a selected opening to produce r2, request/reopen exact review, record editorial acceptance, save an unbound or selected-account publication intention, authorize only a supported release route and reconcile its result. At every transition identify native object, actor, base/result revision and which states did not change. Inject a newer edit before acceptance and a lost response after release admission. The design trace is static; runtime acceptance remains a later obligation.

D3, content retrieval: find the same object from search, Content, Plan and Review after it becomes published, archived or blocked. Filter to a scope with no matches, then simulate unavailable data. The empty messages and recovery paths must remain distinct, and no object may be duplicated merely because a user navigated through a different page.

D4, partial plan application: accept content work, fail Planner allocation and save two of three intentions. Reopen the same plan and resume only the unresolved operations. Verify that a saved intention, accepted reservation and provider schedule remain different. Change timezone and cross an allowed-window boundary before final admission.

D5, responsive and interrupted work: inspect the exact 390-pixel phone designs for editing with keyboard, review of all media, agenda target changes, unknown release and a missing source. At implementation test actual 320-pixel layout, text zoom, keyboard/screen reader, focus return, reduced motion and no-art/low-data variants. Static designs specify these outcomes but do not establish them.

D6, image selection and privacy: exercise actual artifact preview, curated context art, typography fallback and unavailable image under the same suggestion. Each must preserve object identity, source limit, next action and provenance. Revoke preview permission and verify the design does not leak it through a thumbnail, cached search result or AI context. Optional generation is absent from the default path.

D7, downstream learning: a manual copy event yields no publication receipt; an owner-reported post yields only reported evidence; a provider-confirmed post with no analytics yields unknown audience outcomes. Add genuine feedback, disagree with the interpretation, save an experiment idea and reject automatic recurrence. The observation remains preserved independently of the decision.
15:
### Revision 0.3 authority and method use

The owner explicitly rejected repeated homepage structures across the first concept family, praised the revised task-specific C pages, and commissioned a deep adversarial redesign of the full Marketing specification and UX from those images. This extends authorized design work; it does not accept all seventeen consequential choices or commission implementation. The five chosen concept images are retained as source references with exact prompts, byte identities and limits. The rejected earlier family remains historical and is not the current route.

Current main design-product-dossier and craft-review-artifacts definitions were read for this commission. Seven exact dossier reference resource reads failed with 'failed to read skill resource'; no full-reference-load claim is made. The complete verified native Craft counterpart at its stated d47349d basis, project-local method and prior source/critique history supplied supported guidance. This limitation is explicit; no reference text was manufactured. Owner authorization covers this project revision, not silently updating other projects' method adoption.

This project's deliverables are revised together: the same editable native dossier, exact-revision PDF, full-size visual atlas, visual lifecycle catalogue, source assets and navigational routes. Prior candidate 0.2's repaired 53-page export and original/derived visuals remain recoverable history. An atlas is part of this commission's requested package, not a universal requirement imposed on other work. Migration's verified recovery baseline precedes canonical revision writes.
